description: Test script for verifying if the current cellular access technology is within supported technologies, using TDK scripting library.

classes.name: tdklib.TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Wrapper class for TDK test scripting library, used to load modules and create test steps.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test actions.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of loading the test module.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the module load operation.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.
